proof_body:
by
  intro α s x y
  by_cases h : s.r x y
  · left
    ext z
    exact ⟨fun hz => s.iseqv.trans hz h, fun hz => s.iseqv.trans hz (s.iseqv.symm h)⟩
  · right
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2
    intro z hz
    exact h (s.iseqv.trans (s.iseqv.symm hz.1) hz.2)
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) (s : Setoid α) (x y : α), {z | s.r z x} = {z | s.r z y} ∨ {z | s.r z x} ∩ {z | s.r z y} = ∅
